images.title: A bundle of five
images.purpose: Show how a tally bundle is drawn: four strokes with the fifth stroke across them.
images.composition: One large tally bundle centred, with one short label above and one below, lots of white space.
images.exact_structure: Centre: one tally bundle of exactly 4 equal vertical strokes, evenly spaced, in teal #0072B2, crossed by exactly 1 diagonal stroke in reddish purple #CC79A7 running across all four. Nothing else. Exactly 5 strokes in all.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a fifth stroke placed beside the four instead of across them
images.takeaway: The fifth stroke goes across the four to make a bundle of 5.
images.description: One tally bundle of 4 vertical strokes with a fifth stroke drawn across them.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the fifth stroke and say what a bundle counts.

image_decisions.why: A single clear bundle of five is the whole idea of tally marks.
